required_stages.description: Allocate a fresh (B, H, M, D) output of Q's dtype inside run().

One kernel launch: per (query row block, batch, head) read the CSR row range, visit the listed key blocks in stored order, S = scale * Q.K^T in fp32 with causal and sequence-bound -inf masking, online-softmax update (running max with guard, running sum, alpha rescale), P cast to fp16 for P.V, final divide by the guarded row sum and store.

forbidden_substitutions.message: A library attention, softmax or GEMM replaces the core computation.
A dense materialised mask or zero-filled scratch is forbidden; masking must happen inside the kernel.
Host-side decoding of the CSR layout is forbidden; the kernel must consume the CSR arrays directly.
Caching layout-derived or other state across calls is forbidden.
Atomic accumulation suggests a split-key scheme, which is a different structure.
Host-side transpose/copy of Q/K/V is forbidden; in-kernel tile transposes are fine.

required_evidence.message: No matrix-multiply primitive found for Q.K^T / P.V.
No exponential found; online softmax requires exp.
No row-max reduction found; online softmax requires a running maximum.
No -inf masking value found; causal and bound masking are required.
No CSR row-pointer access found; the key blocks must be taken from the layout.

outputs.aliasing: none; the returned (B, H, M, D) tensor must be freshly allocated inside run() and must not share storage with Q, K, V or the layout arrays

timing_boundary.notes: Everything inside run() is timed: shape asserts, the output allocation, optional no-op contiguity guards, host descriptor/metadata construction and the single attention kernel. The CSR layout is consumed raw by the kernel; no host decoding, dense mask, copy or cross-call cache.
